mapper.sql: t.*,s.name AS store_name,c.name AS category_name,m.display_name AS assignee_name
FROM repair_tickets t JOIN repair_stores s ON s.id=t.store_id JOIN repair_categories c ON c.id=t.category_id LEFT JOIN repair_members m ON m.user_id=t.assignee_id
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM repair_tickets WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT ORDER BY t.submitted_at DESC,t.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE repair_tickets SET ticket_no=#{number} WHERE id=#{id}

UPDATE repair_tickets SET asset_id=#{assetId},replacement_asset_id=#{replacementAssetId},facility_snapshot=#{facilitySnapshot},priority=#{priority},status=#{status},resolution_plan=#{resolutionPlan},procurement_required=#{procurementRequired},assignee_id=#{assigneeId},assigned_at=#{assignedAt},accepted_at=#{acceptedAt},first_started_at=#{firstStartedAt},completed_repair_at=#{completedRepairAt},submitted_for_acceptance_at=#{submittedForAcceptanceAt},completed_at=#{completedAt},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version}
mapper.select: SELECT e.*,m.display_name AS actor_name FROM repair_ticket_events e JOIN repair_members m ON m.user_id=e.actor_id WHERE e.ticket_id=#{ticketId} AND e.visibility='PARTICIPANTS'AND e.id<#{before} ORDER BY e.id DESC LIMIT #{size}

SELECT m.user_id FROM repair_members m WHERE m.status='ACTIVE' AND (m.role='HQ_ADMIN' OR (m.role='ENGINEER' AND m.user_id=#{assignee}) OR (m.role='STORE_MANAGER' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM repair_member_stores ms WHERE ms.user_id=m.user_id AND ms.store_id=#{storeId})))
SELECT * FROM repair_ticket_events WHERE ticket_id=#{ticketId} AND action='submit-result' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
